crossRefs.note: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Sirah
people.line: Place near Hebron where Abner was killed by Joab

translations.web: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.
translations.bsb: As soon as Joab had left David, he sent messengers after Abner, who brought him back from the well of Sirah. But David was unaware of it.
translations.kjv: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
translations.asv: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
